events.description: Gentle purple Lucid Light wind-chime shimmer across the Storyverse Void
Glass bottle shattering on the bathroom tile floor
CRT television hissing with cosmic microwave background static
Hourly Sleep-Debt Hotel brass reception bell chime
3D pop-up grimoire pages unfolding and brass relic pieces snapping together
Partial-lucidity cloud rolling across the ice cream shop and fizzling out
Banquet silverware clink and ranch dressing bottle squeeze
Morning bedside alarm chime ringing out just before the first bite lands
